THE WAGES BOARDS ORDINANCE
Notice
APPOINTMENT OF WAGES BOARD SECRETARY

IT is hereby notified that the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations has been pleased to appoint Labour Officer,Mr. Hangili Gurunnehelage Wasantha Gunawardana to be the Secretary of Wages Boards for the under-mentioned tradesestablished under Section 8 of the Wages Boards Ordinance (Chapter 136) in place of the Wages Boards Secretary Mrs.Walpitage Dona Biyanka Sandamali Walpita until further order.
This appointment will be effective from 09.02.2016.
S. M. GOTABAYA JAYARATHNE,Secretary,Ministry of Labour andTrade Union Relations.
Colombo,09th February 2016.
